note: Stored face-recognition test frame — captured live from the edge and stored by the StoreFace node. Use it to A/B a LOCAL sidecar (ai/sidecar/handler.py, CPU InsightFace) against the CLOUD reference embedding (RunPod GPU) that production produced for the exact same input. See compare_local.py.
bbox_note: xyxy in frame pixels — from the edge YuNet detector, delivered via the face_detected event
crop_region_note: what run_face_embedding's crop_to_bbox produces: bbox grown 30% each side, clamped to the frame; this is the exact input sent to the sidecar in production

reference.provider: RunPod GPU sidecar, InsightFace buffalo_l, 512-d L2-normalized ArcFace
